name: tranzl
description: Private, on-device translation, text editing and chat

scripts.pack: electron-packager . Tranzl --platform=darwin --arch=arm64 --no-asar --icon=build/icon.icns --app-bundle-id=com.tranzl.app --overwrite --out=dist --ignore='^/dist$' --ignore='^/build' --ignore='^/scripts' --ignore='^/tests$' --ignore='^/docs$' && codesign --force --deep --sign - dist/Tranzl-darwin-arm64/Tranzl.app && codesign --verify --deep --strict dist/Tranzl-darwin-arm64/Tranzl.app
scripts.install-app: npm run pack && rm -rf /Applications/Tranzl.app && cp -R dist/Tranzl-darwin-arm64/Tranzl.app /Applications/

author: Zoltan Fekete
